identityReview: Matched MIT social-robotics researcher and Jibo co-founder through institutional biography, thesis catalog and current institutional announcements.
lifeStatusEvidence: October 6, 2026 MIT announcement quotes her on the new MIT for America initiative and identifies her as faculty co-director.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Web search/open inspected original institutional and publisher pages on 2026-11-17.
sourceReview.scope: Doctoral degree and birth year from MIT repository; publisher edition metadata; institutional appointment effective dates; RAISE and Day of AI reports; AAAS class; current MIT for America role.
corrections: Birth year 1967 comes from the MIT thesis author authority heading; no precise birthday asserted.
Sc.D. in 2000 is supported by thesis metadata, not inferred from doctoral enrollment.
MIT Press hardcover publication is May 3, 2002, not the Media Lab listing date May 4; paperback dates to August 20, 2004.
2020 full-professor and associate-director appointments take effect July 1, after June 19 announcement.
Day of AI October 20, 2021 is the report date, not the inaugural school event date.
Dean appointment announced January 26, 2022 takes effect February 1.
2024 AAAS Fellows class was announced in 2025; AAAS is distinct from AAAI.
Jibo chief-scientist and chief-experience-officer roles are past roles in her biography.
RAISE and MIT for America are collaborative initiatives; educational and health research does not establish universal benefits or clinical efficacy.
sourceReview.limits: Mostly institutional sources; no independent efficacy or business-outcome assessment. Birth year uses catalog metadata. No human/native-language certification.
